title: Omnistudio Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer – OmniStudio & Communications Cloud


The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable and high‑quality Salesforce solutions within a digital transformation project in the telecommunications industry. You will work with OmniStudio, Salesforce Communications Cloud, and core Salesforce technologies to build optimized business processes. You will test your code, ensure quality through best practices, and collaborate in Agile environments.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement scalable solutions using OmniStudio (OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures).
  • Build and configure applications within Salesforce Communications Cloud (formerly Vlocity CPQ/EPC).
  • Participate in the development of telecom business processes such as quote‑to‑order , customer onboarding , and service provisioning .
  • Write clear, maintainable, and high‑quality code using Apex , LWC , and Salesforce configuration tools.
  • Support integration development using REST, SOAP, JSON, XML .
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, and reviews.
  • Perform unit testing and provide support throughout SIT and UAT cycles.
  • Document technical specifications, solution designs, and deployment guidelines.
  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows using tools such as Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant .


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience with Salesforce development .
  • 2+ years of experience with OmniStudio development.
  • Strong experience with:
  • OmniScripts, FlexCards, DataRaptors, Integration Procedures
  • Salesforce configuration, Apex , and LWC
  • Salesforce Communications Cloud (Vlocity CPQ & EPC)
  • Experience integrating systems using REST/SOAP APIs and working with JSON/XML formats.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Copado, Git, Jenkins, Ant).
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments (SAFe Agile preferred).
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.


Preferred Certifications

  • Salesforce Platform Developer I
  • OmniStudio Developer Certification
  • Salesforce Industries CPQ Developer (nice to have)

title: System Architect (Design System)
description:
Client Summary – Client Corporation

Client Corporation is a global power management leader with a commitment to innovation, reliability, and sustainability. With operations in more than 175 countries, Client designs technologies that improve efficiency, safety, and performance across industrial, electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. As Client expands its digital ecosystem, the company is investing heavily in enterprise architecture, design systems, cloud modernization, and scalable platforms. This role sits at the core of Client’s digital experience strategy and helps shape the future of UI frameworks, enterprise applications, and design consistency across global teams.


Job Description – System Architect (Design System)

Client: Client Corporation

Position: System Architect – Design System

Location: Remote / Hybrid (per Client requirements)


Position Overview

Client’s IT organization is seeking an experienced System Architect – Design System to lead the architecture, design, and end‑to‑end implementation of enterprise‑scale design system solutions. This architect will translate business needs into scalable technical architectures, enforce enterprise standards, and guide development teams through solution execution. As a senior technical leader, this role drives architectural governance, evaluates emerging technologies, and mentors cross‑functional engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Architect and validate enterprise‑grade software and design system solutions.
  • Create architecture artifacts, diagrams, reference models, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure solutions meet performance, availability, and security standards.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead engineering teams through complex technical challenges and solution delivery.
  • Provide mentorship, guidance, and architectural oversight to developers and technical leads.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and integration planning.

Requirements Translation

  • Translate business and UX requirements into well‑defined technical designs.
  • Define system interactions, data flows, integration points, and component‑level architecture.

Governance & Standards

  • Enforce adherence to Client’s enterprise architecture standards and development guidelines.
  • Participate in architecture governance forums and lead solution approval processes.

Future‑State & Scalability Planning

  • Develop future‑state architecture strategies that ensure scalability, performance, and compliance.
  • Recommend improvements that reduce technical debt and increase architectural maturity.

Implementation Oversight

  • Oversee development lifecycle activities to ensure high‑quality, consistent implementation.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across front‑end, back‑end, and integration layers.

Strategic Contribution

  • Influence and contribute to Client’s technology roadmap and long‑term digital strategy.
  • Drive innovation and promote adoption of modern frameworks, tools, and best practices.


Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, architecture, and solution design.
  • Extensive experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM 6.5) including component development and system integration.
  • 6–7 years of front‑end experience with Angular (19+ preferred), NgRx, and modern UI frameworks (Tailwind, Angular Material, PrimeNG).
  • 10+ years of back‑end experience with Java, .NET, Spring Boot, REST services, and database technologies.
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, microservices, cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), and security frameworks.
  • Hands‑on experience with DevOps tools including Git, Maven, NPM, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (JUnit, Jest, etc.).
  • Excellent communication, system documentation, architecture presentation, and leadership skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience aligning solutions with enterprise roadmaps and long‑term architecture strategies.
  • Background in architectural maturity assessment and technical debt remediation.
  • Demonstrated success in team mentorship, innovation leadership, and technology evangelism.


Why This Role Matters

This architect will define and evolve the technical foundation behind Client’s enterprise design system—ensuring consistency, reusability, and engineering excellence across global applications. The role carries high visibility and has direct influence on Client’s digital modernization initiatives, making it a key strategic position within IT.

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.

title: Blockchain Developer
description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Blockchain Developer to build and maintain decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, and blockchain integrations that support our Web3 community hub in art and technology. You will develop secure, scalable solutions for tokenized art, NFT platforms, DeFi features, and community governance tools — enabling creators, collaborators, and users to interact seamlessly in a global Web3 ecosystem. This role involves hands-on coding, testing, and deployment on chains like Ethereum or Solana, with a focus on innovative features that foster collaboration and creativity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement smart contracts: write, audit, and deploy Solidity/Rust code for features like NFT minting, token distribution, DAOs, and royalty mechanisms tailored to art/tech communities.
  • Build dApps and integrations: develop frontend/backend for Web3 apps using frameworks like React, Web3.js/Ethers.js; integrate with wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect) and APIs for seamless user experiences.
  • Optimize for scalability and security: implement gas-efficient code, conduct security audits (e.g., using Slither), and ensure compliance with best practices to prevent vulnerabilities.
  • Collaborate on projects: work with designers, marketers, and community leads to create tools for collaboration (e.g., tokenized events, shared ownership models) in art and technology.
  • Testing and maintenance: write unit/integration tests (Hardhat, Foundry); monitor on-chain performance, debug issues, and upgrade contracts as needed.
  • Research and innovation: explore emerging tech (Layer 2s, zero-knowledge proofs) to enhance platform features; contribute to open-source or community-driven developments.
  • Documentation and support: create technical docs, APIs, and guides for community developers; provide support for integrations and troubleshooting.
Requirements
  • 3–5+ years of experience in blockchain development, with hands-on work on live dApps or smart contracts (e.g., Ethereum/Solana projects); proven portfolio of deployed code.
  • Proficiency in languages and tools: Solidity/Rust for contracts, JavaScript/TypeScript for dApps, frameworks like Truffle/Hardhat/Anchor, and testing libraries.
  • Deep knowledge of Web3 ecosystems: DeFi, NFTs, DAOs, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155), and blockchain concepts (consensus, scalability, security).
  • Experience with art/tech applications: familiarity with NFT platforms, tokenized assets, or creative Web3 tools preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving: ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and ensure secure code in decentralized environments.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (preferred); crypto-native passion with contributions to Web3 projects required.
  • Excellent collaboration skills; ability to work in a fully remote, fast-paced team with global communities.
What We Offer
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$200,000 base salary depending on experience + performance-based bonuses tied to project deliveries and platform growth.
  • Token/equity incentives in community projects and Web3 initiatives.
  • Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, retirement contributions, generous paid time off.
  • Professional development: access to conferences (Devcon, Token2049), tools, and ongoing learning in blockchain/Web3.
  • Opportunity to develop innovative blockchain solutions that connect art, technology, and global Web3 communities.


If you're a blockchain developer excited to build tools for creative Web3 collaboration, send your resume to . We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a GCP DevOps Engineer to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


Only resumes in English will be reviewed. All interviews will be in English only (must be fluent)


We are seeking a highly skilled GCP DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in containerization, serverless architectures, and leveraging GitLab CI/CD for full lifecycle automation, from infrastructure provisioning to application deployment.


Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Architecture & Development: Design and deploy applications using core GCP services, including Cloud Run, Cloud Functions
  • Data Services: Manage and optimize data persistence and analysis using Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, manage, and maintain GCP infrastructure using Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager within a GitOps framework.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Management: Build and maintain sophisticated, multi-stage CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, utilizing GitLab Runners and Docker containers for seamless delivery.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and manage security best practices using Identity and Access Management (IAM) and centralize sensitive information with Secret Manager.
  • Integration & Automation: Securely configure and automate the connection between GitLab CI/CD and GCP resources, specifically by building container images, pushing them to Artifact Registry, and managing deployments via Cloud Deploy or direct service commands.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT Infrastructure related experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • GCP DevOps experience and strong understanding of GCP cloud infrastructure
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, specifically with GCP, including hands-on experience with GCP services like App Engine, Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes Engine, and Cloud SQL.
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable and secure cloud-based infrastructure for PaaS.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools (e.g., Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Professional certification in Google Cloud Platform is highly preferred (e.g., Google Certified Professional Cloud Architect).
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: TechOps Specialist (HL7 Integration)
description:
TechOps (HL7 Integration)


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing healthcare SaaS organization, is seeking a Technical Operations Specialist to support post-sales technical implementations and system integrations.

This role is responsible for configuring and deploying HL7 interfaces within client environments, ensuring secure and accurate data connectivity between the SaaS platform and customer systems. The ideal candidate understands healthcare data workflows, integration standards, and how to work cross-functionally with client IT teams to enable seamless interoperability.

This is a post-sales, client-facing technical role that blends implementation, troubleshooting, and systems integration.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in healthcare IT, technical operations, or systems integration
  • Direct experience working with HL7 interfaces (v2.x preferred)
  • Experience connecting SaaS platforms to EHR or clinical systems
  • Strong understanding of healthcare data structures and workflows
  • Experience working with APIs, endpoints, or secure data transmission protocols
  • Ability to troubleshoot integration issues independently
  • Strong communication skills when working with client IT teams


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within a healthcare SaaS organization
  • Familiarity with EHR systems
  • Experience with interface engines
  • Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant data handling practices


Key Responsibilities


Post-Sales Implementation Support

  • Lead technical onboarding activities following customer contract execution
  • Configure and deploy HL7 interfaces within client instances
  • Coordinate with client IT and EHR teams to establish secure data connections
  • Ensure accurate mapping of inbound and outbound data fields

HL7 & Data Integration

  • Build, configure, and validate HL7 message interfaces
  • Support integration between the SaaS platform and client EHR or clinical systems
  • Troubleshoot data transmission errors and interface failures
  • Validate endpoint connectivity and message formatting

Client Collaboration

  • Serve as technical point of contact during implementation
  • Communicate integration requirements clearly to client technical stakeholders
  • Assist in diagnosing and resolving integration-related issues
  • Support go-live and stabilization efforts

System & Workflow Optimization

  • Monitor integration performance and data accuracy
  • Improve documentation around interface setup and troubleshooting
  • Contribute to process improvements within the technical operations function

title: Creative Designer
description:
About Us:


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We also publish Case Studied, a marketing newsletter with 40,000+ subscribers that breaks down standout campaigns and creative strategies. It’s become a trusted resource for marketers at brands like Shopify, Dr. Squatch, and Magic Spoon—and it’s a core growth engine for Vendry.


The Role:


We’re looking for a Creative Designer to own the visual output across Vendry and Case Studied. This is a hands-on production role—you’ll be responsible for designing the ads that drive our newsletter growth, producing and editing video content, sourcing and managing UGC creators, and designing landing pages and creative assets across the organization.


You’ll work directly with the founder and be the single creative resource for a fast-growing company. That means high ownership, fast feedback loops, and real impact—the ads you design directly drive the pipeline that powers our business.


We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running with Meta ad creative for newsletter growth and expand from there.


Responsibilities:


Ad Creative Production

  • Design 6–8+ static and video ad concepts per month for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns promoting Case Studied and Vendry.
  • Create ads across proven formats: text-over-video, fake social proof (tweets, DMs, Slack messages), aspirational copy overlays, carousels, and AI-assisted imagery.
  • Iterate on top-performing creatives with fresh hooks, visuals, and B-roll to combat ad fatigue and maintain performance.
  • Stay current on organic social trends (especially TikTok and Instagram) and translate them into paid ad concepts that feel native.

Video & UGC

  • Source, brief, and manage UGC creators—writing scripts, coordinating production, and editing final deliverables.
  • Edit short-form video content for ads, including cuts, text overlays, captions, and sound design.
  • Maintain a roster of vetted creators and continuously identify new talent to keep content fresh.

Landing Pages & Web Design

  • Design and build landing pages for ad campaigns, lead magnets, and conversion funnels (experience with Webflow, Beehiiv, or similar tools preferred).
  • A/B test landing page layouts, headlines, and CTAs to improve conversion rates.

Brand & Organizational Creative

  • Produce creative assets across the company as needed: sales decks, social content, email templates, event materials, and internal documents.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity for both Case Studied and Vendry, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

Nice to Have: Brand Expansion

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Vendry brand—identifying opportunities to elevate our visual presence, refine our design system, and strengthen brand recognition as we scale.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in creative/graphic design with a strong portfolio of ad creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing ads for newsletters, B2B, and/or SaaS companies is a must. We need someone who understands performance creative in these contexts, not just general graphic design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects), and/or Canva Pro.
  • Strong video editing skills—comfortable cutting short-form content, adding text overlays, and producing polished ad-ready video.
  • Experience with UGC—sourcing creators, writing briefs/scripts, and managing production workflows.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, hook strategies, ad fatigue cycles, and format requirements.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal). You’ll collaborate daily with a North American team and need to write ad copy, briefs, and creative rationale clearly.
  • Highly organized and self-directed—able to manage your own production calendar, hit deadlines consistently, and work asynchronously across time zones.


Preferred


  • Experience working with landing page builders (Webflow, Beehiiv, Unbounce, or similar).
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics (CTR, CPL, CVR, CPM) and how creative decisions impact them.
  • Experience at a startup, agency, or in a role where you were the sole/primary designer supporting a growing team.
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills.


Why Join Vendry:


This is a rare opportunity to be the creative engine behind a company that’s growing fast and punches well above its weight. You won’t be buried in a design team making minor tweaks to someone else’s vision—you’ll own the entire creative function, work directly with the founder, and see the direct impact of your work on real business results every single week.

We’re a small, collaborative, and fast-moving team that values quality, initiative, and clear communication. If you’re looking for a role where your creative work directly drives growth and you want the autonomy to shape a brand’s visual identity from the ground up, this is it.


How to Apply


Send your portfolio and a brief note about yourself to . We’re especially interested in seeing Meta ad creative, video work, and any newsletter or B2B/SaaS campaign examples. If you’ve managed UGC production, include those examples too.


We move quickly and review portfolios on a rolling basis—if this sounds like your kind of role, don’t wait.

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.


About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.


Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.


Qualifications & Skills:


  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.


What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Creative Designer
description:
About Us:


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We also publish Case Studied, a marketing newsletter with 40,000+ subscribers that breaks down standout campaigns and creative strategies. It’s become a trusted resource for marketers at brands like Shopify, Dr. Squatch, and Magic Spoon—and it’s a core growth engine for Vendry.


The Role:


We’re looking for a Creative Designer to own the visual output across Vendry and Case Studied. This is a hands-on production role—you’ll be responsible for designing the ads that drive our newsletter growth, producing and editing video content, sourcing and managing UGC creators, and designing landing pages and creative assets across the organization.


You’ll work directly with the founder and be the single creative resource for a fast-growing company. That means high ownership, fast feedback loops, and real impact—the ads you design directly drive the pipeline that powers our business.


We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running with Meta ad creative for newsletter growth and expand from there.


Responsibilities:


Ad Creative Production

  • Design 6–8+ static and video ad concepts per month for Meta (Facebook/Instagram) campaigns promoting Case Studied and Vendry.
  • Create ads across proven formats: text-over-video, fake social proof (tweets, DMs, Slack messages), aspirational copy overlays, carousels, and AI-assisted imagery.
  • Iterate on top-performing creatives with fresh hooks, visuals, and B-roll to combat ad fatigue and maintain performance.
  • Stay current on organic social trends (especially TikTok and Instagram) and translate them into paid ad concepts that feel native.

Video & UGC

  • Source, brief, and manage UGC creators—writing scripts, coordinating production, and editing final deliverables.
  • Edit short-form video content for ads, including cuts, text overlays, captions, and sound design.
  • Maintain a roster of vetted creators and continuously identify new talent to keep content fresh.

Landing Pages & Web Design

  • Design and build landing pages for ad campaigns, lead magnets, and conversion funnels (experience with Webflow, Beehiiv, or similar tools preferred).
  • A/B test landing page layouts, headlines, and CTAs to improve conversion rates.

Brand & Organizational Creative

  • Produce creative assets across the company as needed: sales decks, social content, email templates, event materials, and internal documents.
  • Maintain and evolve the visual identity for both Case Studied and Vendry, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint.

Nice to Have: Brand Expansion

  • Contribute to the evolution of the Vendry brand—identifying opportunities to elevate our visual presence, refine our design system, and strengthen brand recognition as we scale.


Qualifications:


Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in creative/graphic design with a strong portfolio of ad creative work.
  • Demonstrated experience designing ads for newsletters, B2B, and/or SaaS companies is a must. We need someone who understands performance creative in these contexts, not just general graphic design.
  • Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro or After Effects), and/or Canva Pro.
  • Strong video editing skills—comfortable cutting short-form content, adding text overlays, and producing polished ad-ready video.
  • Experience with UGC—sourcing creators, writing briefs/scripts, and managing production workflows.
  • Understanding of Meta Ads creative best practices: aspect ratios, safe zones, hook strategies, ad fatigue cycles, and format requirements.
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal). You’ll collaborate daily with a North American team and need to write ad copy, briefs, and creative rationale clearly.
  • Highly organized and self-directed—able to manage your own production calendar, hit deadlines consistently, and work asynchronously across time zones.


Preferred


  • Experience working with landing page builders (Webflow, Beehiiv, Unbounce, or similar).
  • Familiarity with performance marketing metrics (CTR, CPL, CVR, CPM) and how creative decisions impact them.
  • Experience at a startup, agency, or in a role where you were the sole/primary designer supporting a growing team.
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills.


Why Join Vendry:


This is a rare opportunity to be the creative engine behind a company that’s growing fast and punches well above its weight. You won’t be buried in a design team making minor tweaks to someone else’s vision—you’ll own the entire creative function, work directly with the founder, and see the direct impact of your work on real business results every single week.

We’re a small, collaborative, and fast-moving team that values quality, initiative, and clear communication. If you’re looking for a role where your creative work directly drives growth and you want the autonomy to shape a brand’s visual identity from the ground up, this is it.


How to Apply


Send your portfolio and a brief note about yourself to . We’re especially interested in seeing Meta ad creative, video work, and any newsletter or B2B/SaaS campaign examples. If you’ve managed UGC production, include those examples too.


We move quickly and review portfolios on a rolling basis—if this sounds like your kind of role, don’t wait.

title: Support Specialist
description:

Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands’ customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we’re just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub. 


Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!



About the opportunity

As a Support Specialist at Drip, you’ll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F.

﻿This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew. 




We’re engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?



Key Responsibilities:
  • Troubleshooting & Problem Solving
  • Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues.
  • Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices.
  • Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed.
  • Customer Support
  • Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video.
  • Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner.
  • Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system.
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs.
  • Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems.
  • Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Escalation Management
  • Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem.
  • Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.

    • Skills & Qualifications:
    • Technical Expertise:
    • Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications.
    • Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components.
    • Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools.
    • Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems.
    • Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.g., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
    • Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly.
    • Problem-solving Ability:
    • An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly.
    • Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
    • Communication Skills:
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users.
    • Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction.
    • Organizational Skills:
    • Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities.
    • Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.



    Preferred Experience:
    • Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role.
    • Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.g., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies.
    • Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS).
    • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required).
    • Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams.
    • Previous work with an American company
    Education & Certifications:
    • Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required.
    • Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued.
    • Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.


    Who You Are:

    • A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth.
    • You’re an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn’t run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip
    • Passion for helping others internally and externally 
    • Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail
    • In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

Our trusted high-growth technology partner is building a production AI platform that transforms disconnected data into measurable business growth. With customers already onboarding and the platform live in production, they are hiring a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to scale their next-generation AI systems.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer to own the intersection of agentic AI and modern web development . You will build the intelligent backend powering a multi-agent system and the interactive frontend delivering real-time AI experiences . This role requires strong architectural judgment — the platform runs on Vercel , and decisions around caching, bandwidth, cost efficiency, and production reliability are critical.

If you are excited about building AI agents that work in production , designing streaming chat experiences , and solving complex orchestration challenges , this is the opportunity for you.



What You'll Do:


  • Design and optimize production prompts for LLMs and build multi-agent workflows with smart routing, specialization, and human-in-the-loop approval gates
  • Build stateful agent workflows with planning, execution, and observation loops — making sure agents reliably follow structured steps even when users go off-script
  • Create streaming chat UIs with real-time rendering, tool call visualization, and interactive artifacts
  • Connect agents to analytical databases for live data retrieval, SQL generation, and knowledge base access through RAG pipelines
  • Own performance across the full stack — caching strategies, bandwidth optimization, and keeping Vercel costs under control
  • Implement LLMOps practices including prompt versioning, observability, and cost tracking.



What You Bring


  • 3–5+ years of progressive experience in full-stack development.
  • Strong TypeScript skills across frontend, backend, and agent logic
  • Production experience with React or Next.js (App Router, Server Components, API routes)
  • Hands-on work with LLM agent frameworks — LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent loops
  • Production prompt engineering: system prompts, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool-calling patterns
  • Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK (useChat, streamText, streaming patterns)
  • Familiarity with durable workflow engines like Trigger.dev or Temporal
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, or knowledge retrieval systems
  • Background in performance optimization for Vercel-hosted applications
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or building a product from 0 to 1.



Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Data Scientist - Especialista
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na frente de Alocação/Abastecimento em varejo, com foco em decisão de estoque orientada por dados (reduzir ruptura/excesso e aumentar venda/margem com nível de serviço).

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar (ponta a ponta) iniciativas de Ciência de Dados para alocação/abastecimento no varejo, do problema ao impacto em produção.
  • Desenvolver, validar e evoluir em todo ciclo de vida (exploração → deploy → monitoramento) modelos e análises (forecast, propensão, anomalias, clusterização, otimização) para decisões de estoque e demanda.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de sucesso (modelo + negócio) e garantir monitoramento, logs/observabilidade.
  • Traduzir achados em recomendação acionável e atuar em squad/quarteto multidisciplinar (produto, engenharia, negócio, dados e design).
  • Garantir clareza de premissas e limites das soluções (dados, regras e critérios), com documentação e governança para adoção e manutenção.
  • Mentorar cientistas mais júnior com rigor técnico (revisão de abordagem, boas práticas e desenvolvimento).
  • Manter a documentação dos sistemas/modelos/dados atualizada e relevante, garantindo rastreabilidade e seguindo boas práticas de versionamento, code review e reprodutibilidade.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada com entregas em produção e impacto mensurável.
  • Domínio de Python e SQL (modelagem, feature engineering, pipelines analíticos), com prática de Git/versionamento e revisão de código (code review) em fluxo colaborativo.
  • Base forte em estatística aplicada (validação, métricas, vieses, experimentação quando aplicável).
  • Capacidade de transformar problema de negócio em solução técnica (trade-offs claros, foco em valor).
  • Boa comunicação e autonomia para atuar como referência técnica em iniciativas multiárea com público técnico e não técnico.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em varejo / estoque / alocação / omnichannel .
  • Domínio prático de IA/ML aplicado (da modelagem à operação): forecast , propensão , anomalias , clusterização/segmentação , otimização , recomendação e noções de MLOps/observabilidade, pipelines e ambientes cloud (GCP) .
  • Experiência com GenAI/LLMs para explicabilidade/assistentes (ex.: RAG, agentes, geração de explicações e recomendações com guardrails).
  • Ter construído soluções de decisão e explicação , como:


  • Explicar políticas e movimentações de estoque (por que decidiu X) com feature importance/SHAP e narrativas.
  • Monitoramento + alertas (drift, performance, ruptura/excesso recorrente, mudança de padrão produto×loja, lead time real).
  • Uso de variáveis externas (clima, eventos, datas comerciais, economia) como features/contexto.
  • Segmentação inteligente e priorização produto×loja com base em comportamento real.

Buscamos alguém proativo, comprometido, flexível, resiliente, comunicativo e colaborativo.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Pleno (Full Stack com foco em IA)
description:
Na DreamSquad , criamos soluções digitais baseadas em IA Generativa que resolvem desafios reais de negócio com arquitetura moderna, escalável e orientada a performance. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — da concepção à produção — integrando agentes de IA, pipelines de RAG, bancos de dados e infraestrutura em cloud com foco em impacto, qualidade e experiência do usuário.


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Pleno (Full Stack com foco em IA) para atuar na construção de produtos inteligentes, conectando backend em Python/FastAPI a interfaces modernas em React/Next.js. Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, que goste de arquitetura, performance e boas práticas, e que queira participar ativamente das decisões técnicas — desde a implementação de APIs e pipelines de RAG até a otimização de latência, consumo de tokens e integração com serviços AWS.


Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de Produtos de IA

  • Desenvolver o backend utilizando Python e FastAPI , conectando com o frontend em React / Next.js .
  • Criar interfaces para interação com Agentes de IA , como chats, dashboards e visualizações de dados.
  • Garantir uma experiência fluida e performática para o usuário final.

Arquitetura e Implementação de RAG

  • Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) no backend.
  • Desenvolver componentes visuais que exibam fontes e referências recuperadas via Vector Stores (ex: Vector S3) .
  • Otimizar o fluxo de dados entre frontend, backend e serviços de IA na AWS.

Qualidade, Integração e Performance

  • Integrar agentes de IA com bancos de dados transacionais.
  • Monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e tempo de resposta dos modelos.
  • Garantir usabilidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Backend

  • Python avançado, com uso de Type Hints , programação assíncrona (asyncio/FastAPI ) e padrões de projeto.
  • Desenvolvimento e documentação de APIs RESTful (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Conhecimento em autenticação, autorização, microsserviços e gerenciamento de dependências.

Frontend

  • JavaScript moderno e TypeScript (ES6+) .
  • Experiência com frameworks SPA baseados em componentes (React, Vue.js ou similares ).
  • Consumo de APIs REST, tratamento de estados assíncronos e erros.
  • Gerenciamento de estado (Context API, Redux, Zustand ou similares).
  • Estilização com CSS moderno, Tailwind, Styled Components ou similares.

Dados e Cloud

  • Modelagem e otimização de bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou MariaDB ).
  • Versionamento com Git (Git Flow, Code Review).
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema AWS .
  • Familiaridade com integração de modelos de IA generativa (LLMs) .


Diferenciais

  • Streaming em tempo real com WebSockets ou SSE .
  • Experiência com AWS Bedrock , Strands Agents SDK ou interfaces conversacionais.
  • Uso de bancos de dados vetoriais (Vector S3, Pinecone, pgvector ).
  • Docker e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ).
  • Testes automatizados no backend (Pytest ) e frontend (Jest, Cypress, Testing Library ).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!


Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

title: Compliance Officer
description:
Compliance Officer


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We are looking for a meticulous and proactive Compliance Officer to ensure our operations and business activities adhere to all legal, technical and regulatory requirements, as well as internal policies. As a key member of the compliance team, you will work across departments to promote a strong compliance culture and help safeguard the company’s integrity and reputation.


Responsibilities:


  • Monitor and ensure compliance with relevant regulatory authorities (MGA, Mincetur, SPA, AGCO etc.) 
  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS).
  • Conduct regular audits and technical assessments to evaluate risk and compliance.
  • Develop and maintain compliance documentation, including security policies, data handling procedures, and audit reports.
  • Assist Chief Compliance officer to launch the new project in existing or new markets.
  • Stay up to date with changes in laws and regulations affecting data privacy,  various regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, and industry standards.
  • Provide guidance and training to staff on compliance-related matters.
  • Manage third-party vendor compliance assessments and onboarding processes.
  • Coordinate internal and external audits; respond to audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Assist in incident response investigations and ensure post-incident compliance actions are executed.


Requirements:


  • 2-4 years of experience in compliance or risk/aml management (IT security would be a plus).
  • Previous experience in compliance, data protection laws and cyber security.
  • Exceptional documentation and analytical skills.


Working with us implies:

﻿

  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills. We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

title: Desenvolvimento Java AWS - Pleno - 124105
description:

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.
