O que estamos buscando?


Desenvolvimento Salesforce Sênior


Requisitos:

  • Desenvolvedor Java experiente e com conhecimentos em Amazon Web Services (AWS) para se juntar à nossa equipe de tecnologia. O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações robustas e escaláveis em Java, integrando-as com serviços na nuvem AWS.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento com Java 8/ 11+, incluindo frameworks como Spring, Spring boot, Hibernate ou Java EE. Proficiência em AWS, com experiência prática em serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, IAM, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, SSM entre outros. Conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços e práticas de desenvolvimento orientado a serviços (SOA). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (por exemplo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB). Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação, como Jenkins, GitLab CI ou AWS CodePipeline. Conhecimento em containers e orquestração, como Docker, EKS e Kubernetes. Experiência com práticas de DevOps e infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando ferramentas como Terraform ou AWS CloudFormation. Habilidade para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente e colaborativa. Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas. Diferenciais: Certificações AWS, como AWS Certified Developer ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect. Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban). Conhecimento em segurança na nuvem e boas práticas de proteção de dados. Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Contribuições para projetos open source ou participação em comunidades técnicas.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento em Business Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência com Orchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento em Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Gympass;

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Engenheiro de dados (Inglês fluente)


Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior com inglês fluente qualificado com uma base sólida em desenvolvimento baseado em SQL. Essa função se concentrará na criação e manutenção de pipelines de dados usando o PySpark, com SQL como a linguagem de codificação principal. O candidato também terá uma boa compreensão das estruturas de modelagem de dados (como modelagem dimensional Kimball) e experiência no suporte a datawarehouses e data marts.


Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados em lote usando o PySpark (focado em SQL)

Escreva e otimize consultas SQL complexas para dar suporte à lógica de negócios e às necessidades de relatórios

Entenda os requisitos de forma autônoma e traduza para código

Transforme e integre dados de diversas fontes em tabelas Iceberg e Snowflake

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de data marts e conjuntos de dados selecionados para consumo comercial

Colabore com analistas de negócios para entender as necessidades de dados

Monitore e gerencie trabalhos de dados em execução no AWS EMR orquestrados pelo Airflow, aproveitando o S3, o Glue e outros serviços da AWS

Garanta a qualidade, a consistência e o desempenho dos dados em todo o pipeline




Qualificações preferenciais

Experiência na criação e gerenciamento de data marts

Exposição ao Airflow ou outras ferramentas de orquestração

Familiaridade com ferramentas de infraestrutura como código, como o Terraform

Compreensão dos padrões ODS (Operational Data Store) e arquitetura de data lake

title: Cientista de Dados - Sênior
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Resumo: Atuar como referência técnica e analítica na estruturação, evolução e confiabilidade dos dados de Ad Intelligence, transformando grandes volumes de dados complexos em insights estratégicos que apoiem decisões de negócio, desenvolvimento de produto e melhoria contínua dos processos operacionais. O cargo combina excelência técnica em Data Science com forte entendimento de mídia, metodologia e negócio, atuando como elo entre Dados, Produto, Operações e áreas comerciais, garantindo que o dado seja consistente, confiável, relevante e acionável para o mercado.

  • Monitorar continuamente a qualidade, cobertura e consistência dos dados, identificando e investigando desvios, gaps e comportamentos atípicos.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do conhecimento analítico e metodológico da empresa, por meio de documentação, treinamentos, apresentações e troca ativa com outros times.
  • Participar de interações com clientes e fornecedores quando necessário, explicando metodologias, análises e implicações dos dados de forma clara e transparente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências em mídia, digital, cross-media, Data Science e Analytics, propondo inovações aplicáveis ao contexto da Kantar.



Conhecimento Essencial:

  • Forte experiência em análise de dados, modelagem estatística e Data Science.
  • Domínio de Python e/ou R e SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).
  • Experiência com grandes volumes de dados e pipelines analíticos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em problemas analíticos e vice-versa.
  • Comunicação clara, didática e colaborativa.



Conhecimento Desejável:

  • Entendimento de mídia, publicidade e métricas de investimento (ou capacidade de aprender rapidamente).

O que oferecemos?

title: Head of Community
description:
Warmy.io — Remote | Global | B2B SaaS | AI

Warmy is not building “a community.”

We are building the home of email deliverability on the internet.

If someone works in email — agencies, SDR leaders, founders, growth teams, ESPs — we want one natural place they belong.

That place is Warmy.

We’re looking for a builder. A connector. A natural networker.


Someone who can turn customers into advocates, strangers into members, and conversations into movements.

If you’ve ever thought: “I could build the HubSpot of deliverability communities” — this role is for you.

About Warmy

Warmy is a revolutionary AI-powered email deliverability platform helping companies land in the inbox, not spam. We serve customers worldwide and are scaling fast with a fully remote international team.

We move quickly. We care about impact. We measure results.

Your Mission

Build the largest and most trusted global community in email deliverability.

Not a Slack group.

Not a newsletter.

A real ecosystem where professionals learn, share, connect, and grow.

  • A thriving private community (Slack / Circle / platform of your choice)

  • Relationships with agencies, ESPs, and industry experts
  • Events, webinars, office hours, and meetups
  • Educational initiatives and certifications
  • Feedback loops between customers and product
  • Ambassador and partner programs
  • A sense of belonging around the Warmy brand

You will own the community vision from zero to global scale.

  • Recruit and onboard high-value members
  • Create engagement systems and rituals
  • Launch and run events (virtual and in-person)
  • Work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams

  • Turn community insights into growth opportunities

Who You Are
  • 4+ years building or managing communities (SaaS, tech, or professional communities preferred)
  • Naturally social and relationship-driven
  • Comfortable speaking publicly and hosting events
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution skills
  • High ownership mentality
  • Entrepreneurial mindset — you create opportunities
  • You enjoy helping people succeed
  • You move fast and learn fast

If you love spreadsheets more than people, this is not your role.

We are a KPI-driven company. Success will be measured by:

  • Community growth and active members
  • Engagement and participation rates
  • Customer retention and advocacy
  • Partner relationships created
  • Pipeline influenced by community
  • Brand authority in the industry


Why Join Warmy
  • Fully remote international team

  • High autonomy and ownership
  • Direct impact on company growth
  • Work closely with founder and leadership
  • Opportunity to build a category-defining ecosystem
  • Competitive compensation + performance incentives


The Type of Person Who Thrives Here

You might be a fit if:

  • You believe communities can change industries
  • You love connecting people
  • You enjoy building things from scratch
  • You are proactive and bold
  • You want to create something globally recognized


If you want to manage a forum — this is not the job.

If you want to build the center of an industry — let’s talk.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Aqui, trabalho é esforço, resultado e entrega .

Não seguimos a chamada “cultura do mimimi”.

Acreditamos em um ambiente justo, com reconhecimento proporcional ao desempenho , onde quem se dedica, cresce.

  • Gestão humanizada — Valorizamos a diversidade e quem você é ️‍ . Para nós humanização começa com quem está aqui dentro.
  • Day-off no aniversário — Aproveite seu dia para comemorar.

  • Caju Benefícios Flexíveis — Disponibilizamos R$600 por mês para você utilizar em benefícios flexíveis.
  • Rapidoc — Acesso ao maior hub de saúde corporativa digital do Brasil. Disponibilizamos para você e 3 familiares pago 100% pela nossa empresa.

  • Adicional no salário caso utilize equipamentos próprios para trabalho remoto — Afinal respeitamos seus equipamentos próprios e vamos te pagar pela utilização dos mesmos, caso necessário.


Como se candidatar


Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn e mantenha seu currículo atualizado .

É obrigatório que o número do CRC ativo conste no currículo para validação.


Caso possua, anexe certificações e destaque projetos/rotinas relevantes (fechamento contábil, ECD/ECF, apuração de tributos, acompanhamento de legislação e uso do Sistema Domínio).


Nosso processo seletivo será feito em 4 fases com previsão de contratação ainda neste mês de Fev/26.


Venha construir sua carreira com a gente e fazer parte de um time que está transformando o futuro da contabilidade e das empresas!

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: Senior Node.js Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Node.js Backend Engineer

Contract: 12 months

Hours: UK/CET

Rate: $300 USD per day

Location: Fully Remote


Overview

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to take ownership of core platform services, helping evolve an existing AWS-based system into a more scalable, modular architecture. This is a hands-on product backend role with real responsibility over performance, reliability, and system design.

  • Lead MySQL / Aurora performance optimisation (queries, indexing, scaling, reliability)

  • Contribute to observability (Grafana) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship high-quality backend features

  • Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript
  • MySQL (Aurora), Redis
  • AWS (ECS, Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront)
  • Terraform, Grafana


Must have

  • Strong Node.js + NestJS
  • Solid MySQL optimisation experience in production environments
  • Deep AWS hands-on experience
  • Comfortable using AI dev tools day-to-day (Copilot / Claude / similar)

title: Portuguese to English – Medical Video Remote Interpreter (VRI)
description:
Experience REQUIRED in medical interpreting (VRI or OPI)

Location: 100% Remote

Salary: $7 USD per hour

️ Schedule: Monday to Sunday (2 days off per week assigned by the client)


About Us

First Contact BPO is a nearshore outsourcing provider offering services such as language interpretation, customer support, and technical assistance. The company emphasizes efficiency and high-quality service, ensuring clients’ needs are fully met.


We’re Hiring Medical Interpreters!

Join our remote team and support communication in medical settings through Video Remote Interpreting (VRI) between Portuguese and English .

We are looking for experienced medical interpreters who have worked in VRI or OPI environments and are confident supporting doctors, nurses, and patients in real-time interpretation sessions.


✅ What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ months of proven experience in medical interpretation (preferably in VRI or OPI platforms)
  • Native or near-native proficiency in Portuguese and strong English skills (verbal and written)
  • Clear enunciation, professional tone, and a pleasant, articulate voice
  • Excellent listening, retention, and note-taking skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and handle fast-paced environments with professionalism
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact with people from diverse backgrounds
  • Proficient with computers and comfortable using remote tools and platforms


️ Mandatory Technical Requirements

  • Laptop or desktop with Windows 11 (Intel i5 8th Gen or equivalent / 8GB RAM )
  • (Mac/iOS is NOT allowed)
  • USB headset with microphone (for clear audio communication)
  • Stable wired internet connection via Ethernet cable or adapter
  • (Wi-Fi is NOT allowed)
  • 10 Mbps Download
  • 3 Mbps Upload
  • Jitter ≤ 30 ms
  • Latency ≤ 150 ms
  • Webcam with a minimum resolution of 1280 x 720 pixels (required for video interpretation sessions)


Responsibilities

  • Accurately interpret spoken information between Portuguese and English
  • Assist doctors, healthcare providers, and customers with individuals who do not speak English
  • Maintain strict confidentiality in accordance with company policies
  • Provide high-quality service and positive interaction with patients, customers, and healthcare professionals
  • Ensure clear and professional communication during video remote interpreting sessions


We Offer Amazing Perks

  • Above-market salary
  • Two days off per week
  • Permanent work-from-home position
  • Real growth opportunities within a stable company
  • Referral and other bonuses
  • Immediate hiring opportunities

description:

Metrobi is a fulfillment platform designed to support local businesses, particularly in industries like food and beverage. Intro video:

  • Task Definition & Refinement:

Review and write descriptions for tasks about new features, improvements and bug fixes. Ensure problems are well explained and solutions are testable and aligned with product goals. Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable tasks.

After new features or fixes go live, verify whether they truly solved the original problem and improved the targeted user or business metrics.

Notes

  • This is a full-time remote position.
  • Hiring interviews are online.

title: Partnership Manager for Integrated Platforms
description:

Through our Antom brand, we empower merchants worldwide to connect with over one billion consumers via seamless, secure, and innovative payment solutions. We are driven by the mission to use technology to provide inclusive financial services for individuals and small businesses globally.


The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of digital commerce? Ant International is looking for a strategic and high-impact Partnership for Integrated Platform to drive our expansion in Brazil. In this role, you will be a key driver of Antom’s growth, identifying prospecting opportunities and building the foundational partnerships that will scale our presence in one of the world’s most exciting fintech markets.


Key Responsibilities: What You’ll Do

  • Partnership Development & Sales Ownership: Work with various types of partners and platforms to actively identify, prospect, develop, and close key partnerships, leading and owning the full sales process.
  • Revenue & Growth: Consistently acquire new partners and drive revenue through efficient partnerships management, ensuring agreements are closed in a timely manner.
  • Market Intelligence & Networking: Stay informed on all relevant industry trends, the competitive landscape, and customer needs, representing the company at various industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with partners and internal teams to manage expectations. Work closely with technical implementation and product teams to deliver solutions based on customer needs.
  • Onboarding & Client Experience: Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to ensure clients are on-boarded as quickly as possible while maintaining an excellent client experience.


Who You Are: Required Skills

  • Experience: 8+ years of working inside TOP BR platforms or PSPs managing partnerships.
  • Networking Skills: Strong networking skills with an active network at C-level with international trade merchants within Brazil.
  • Proven Track Record: Success in delivering complex integrated sales and a history of being a relentless new business hunter with an exceptional track record of overachievement.
  • Strategic Thinking: Sharp strategic thinker who can think outside the box and adapt to fast-paced, high-growth, and complex sales cycles.
  • Sales Methodology: Knowledge of consultative/solution sales process and experience with the “Challenger” approach, including buyer profiling and risk assessment.
  • Relationship Management: Strong experience in developing and maintaining global, cultural, and long-term client relationships that sustain results.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency. Mandarin is a strong plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree in Business/Finance.
  • An extensive network across Brazilian financial institutions and major retailers.


Why Join Ant International?

At Ant International, we thrive on innovation and global connectivity. You’ll be joining a team of builders who are redefining how the world pays and does business. If you are a visionary leader with a passion for the fintech revolution, we want to meet you.


Apply today and help us build a more inclusive financial future.

Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

A posição de AI exige uma combinação de visão estratégica e expertise técnica em inteligência artificial, habilidades interpessoais e interesse em atuar próximo ao universo comercial. O foco está na construção de propostas assertivas durante a prospecção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, garantindo soluções alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e escaláveis para o futuro.

  • Implementar modelos de IA, validando performance e garantindo integração nas arquiteturas existentes.
  • Desenvolver pipelines robustos de dados: coleta, processamento, treinamento e deploy de modelos.
  • Integrar soluções de IA em ambientes de produção, alinhando-se às melhores práticas de MLOps (monitoramento, automação e escalabilidade, conhecimento sobre MlFlow ou plataformas como AzureML ou Google VertexAI).

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e deploy de modelos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de MLOps e CI/CD (MLflow, Kubeflow, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Sólida experiência com bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL e práticas de otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com serviços cloud computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiaridade com arquiteturas de sistemas, pipelines de dados e boas práticas de integração de APIs (REST, GraphQL).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com AI Generativa e modelos LLMs (ex.: GPT, BERT).

  • Experiência em com Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes ou ferramentas como Azure Container Apps (ou relativas).
  • Vivência em ambientes com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência colaborando em projetos com arquitetos de soluções ou times comerciais.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:

Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.

As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features

  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)

  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


Que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

– Sua missão principal será a manutenção e o suporte especializado das aplicações core. Você não apenas corrigirá bugs, mas atuará na saúde contínua do ecossistema tecnológico.

– Atuar no suporte para aplicações desenvolvidas em Java, garantindo que os sistemas core permaneçam operacionais e performáticos.

– Garantir que as integrações e a lógica de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO) estejam alinhadas às necessidades do suporte.

– Graduação completa em áreas de Tecnologia da Informação.

– Domínio absoluto de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO).

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Especialista de Produtos Acadêmicos
description:
Especialista de Produtos Acadêmicos


Seja um educador ou educadora no Ecossistema Ânima e venha transformar o país pela educação.

ESPECIALISTA DE PRODUTOS ACADÊMICOS


Essa posição é para atuar na Diretoria de Expansão e Novos Negócios, na frente de Lifelong Learning, contribuindo para a concepção, desenvolvimento e validação de novos produtos educacionais e parcerias estratégicas.

Somos uma empresa em constante evolução, que enxerga em cada detalhe novas formas de promover a educação. Essa é a essência que nos faz diferentes.


Ah! Independente de cor, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, origem, religião ou qualquer outra característica, se você tem desejo e energia para contribuir para a transformação de vidas por meio da Educação, aqui é o seu lugar!


Confira mais sobre a nossa oportunidade.


Do que você precisa para concorrer à vaga:

  • Formação superior completa, com MBA em Administração, Engenharia, Marketing, Design, Tecnologia, Educação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de 4 a 5 anos com desenvolvimento de produtos, inovação ou novos negócios.

Domínio em:

  • Gestão de Produtos
  • Design Thinking, Lean e metodologias Ágeis
  • Modelagem de Negócios
  • Análise de viabilidade econômica
  • Indicadores financeiros e KPIs
  • Storytelling e apresentação executiva
  • Inglês intermediário.


Como será seu dia a dia como educador ou educadora:

Você será responsável por transformar diretrizes estratégicas em soluções educacionais inovadoras, economicamente viáveis e escaláveis, atuando desde a concepção até a validação e recomendação de escala.

Principais responsabilidades:


  • Conceber e desenvolver novos produtos educacionais (proposta de valor, desenho pedagógico, modelagem de negócio e MVPs).
  • Conduzir processos de discovery e validação de mercado, assegurando aderência à demanda e viabilidade econômica.
  • Planejar e executar ciclos de experimentação com metodologias ágeis e frameworks de inovação.
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias estratégicas com edtechs e empresas.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com áreas Acadêmica, Marketing, Operações, Tecnologia e Design Educacional.
  • Monitorar indicadores como time-to-market, receita incremental, margem, NPS e taxa de validação de MVPs.
  • Apoiar a sistematização de métodos e boas práticas de inovação.
  • Atuar como referência técnica em inovação dentro da Diretoria de Lifelong Learning.


Conhecimentos que são bacanas para essa posição:

  • Estruturação de parcerias estratégicas.
  • Experiência com ambientes de inovação e novos negócios.
  • Vivência em ecossistemas educacionais ou edtechs.


Entenda como é o modelo para essa vaga:

Modelo: Remoto

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Golang Data Engineer
description:
Golang Data Engineer #2613

Position Summary:


Our partner is a quantitative trading organization where live market data, low-latency systems, and proprietary models directly drive capital allocation decisions. As the platform continues to scale, the team is adding a senior engineer to own the real-time streaming ingestion systems that power live trading. You’ll build production-grade Go services that consume live WebSocket feeds, process and time-slice high-throughput market data, and deliver reliable inputs to a C-based trading engine running on AWS. The focus is demanding and meaningful: streaming reliability, automated failover, observability, and production debugging in a latency-sensitive environment where performance and correctness directly impact outcomes. If you enjoy building systems where milliseconds matter and your work influences real capital in motion, this is engineering at its sharpest.


Experience and Education:


  • BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on experience/field
  • Hands-on experience building production-grade distributed system for real-time or streaming environments
  • Strong production experience developing backend or systems services in Go
  • Experience implementing WebSocket-based live data ingestion
  • Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, specifically EC2 and S3
  • Experience building and deploying containerized services, ideally in Kubernetes environments
  • Experience supporting low-latency, high-availability systems where downtime or delay had direct business impact


Skills and Strengths:


  • Go
  • Real-time streaming systems
  • WebSockets
  • Low-latency architecture
  • Production service development
  • AWS EC2
  • AWS S3
  • Kubernetes
  • Containerization
  • Monitoring
  • Observability
  • Prometheus
  • High-throughput data processing
  • Failover design
  • Distributed systems
  • Debugging live production systems
  • Time-series data handling
  • Data pipeline development
  • Concurrency patterns
  • Systems reliability engineering



Primary Job Responsibilities:


  • Rebuild and own the production-grade, real-time market data ingestion system end-to-end
  • Develop high-performance Go services that consume live market data over WebSockets
  • Process and manage high-throughput streaming data across approximately 1,500 equities
  • Aggregate and time-slice streaming data for accurate downstream model consumption
  • Deliver structured, low-latency data feeds to a C-based trading engine running on AWS EC2
  • Design and implement automatic failover from live market feeds to delayed backup streams
  • Ensure data integrity and correctness during feed transitions and recovery scenarios
  • Maintain and validate the historical data ingestion pipeline sourcing from AWS S3
  • Instrument services with monitoring and observability to detect latency spikes, data gaps, and system degradation
  • Debug and resolve live production streaming failures with minimal business disruption
  • Optimize ingestion services for latency, throughput, and fault tolerance
  • Deploy and operate containerized services within cloud-native environments
  • Collaborate directly with technical leadership on architectural decisions and performance tradeoffs
  • Operate independently without daily direction, taking full ownership of reliability and delivery
  • Continuously improve system resilience to support live trading without manual intervention

title: Mechanical Engineer
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.


Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.


We are recruiting hands-on Mechanical / Electrical / HVAC / Facilities generalists with a strong mechanical background to support long-term contractor requirements


Typical Responsibilities

Carry out hands-on work across mechanical / facilities systems, supporting safe, reliable operations.

Interpret engineering drawings to diagnose issues, plan tasks, and verify correct installation/repair.

Support basic troubleshooting across HVAC / electrical interfaces as required for a multi-skilled generalist.

Complete job documentation and communicate clearly in English with site teams and stakeholders.

Follow site safety rules and participate in screening/compliance requirements.


Candidate Profile

Multi-skill background (mechanical-heavy with exposure to electrical/HVAC/facilities).

Previous contractor experience in industrial, energy, manufacturing, or large facilities environments.

Willingness to work in the Balkans region and/or broader Central Asia pipeline locations.


Key Requirements

Mechanical systems experience and ability to read engineering drawings

Strong English (mandatory)

Ability to pass background checks


What We Can Offer

Competitive day rate and standby rate

Accommodation, travel, and food/per diem covered


Compliance / Screening

All candidates must be able to complete a background check.


Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Mechanical Engineer to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Business Development Representative Mid
description:
About the company:

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code is expanding US Business Development team and looking for a highly proactive, organized, and fluent English speaker to join as a BDR.   • Use tools like Apollo, LinkedIn, and pre-built cadences to reach out to prospects.
  • Make cold calls when necessary.
  • Keep interactions and activities updated in Salesforce.
  • Manage multiple campaigns simultaneously across many business areas (AI, cloud, staffing, etc.).
  • Partner closely with Account Executives.

  • Fluent English (spoken and written).
  • Previous experience as a BDR or SDR.
  • Highly organized and able to follow structured processes.
  • Comfortable using prospecting and automation tools (e.g., Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, results-driven, and motivated by performance.


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling technology solutions (e.g., Google Cloud, AI, Salesforce).
  • Background in consulting or IT services companies.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce as a CRM.

Perfil Ideal

  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.

  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.

  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.

title: Data Governance Architect
description:
N-iX is a global software development company founded in 2002, connecting over 2,400+ tech professionals across 40+ countries. We deliver innovative technology solutions in cloud computing, data analytics, AI, embedded software,IoT, and more to global industry leaders and Fortune 500 companies. Join us to create technology that drives real change for businesses and people across the world.

The Data Governance Architect will be responsible for creating and executing a cross-functional enterprise data program that supports overlapping data needs across tax, finance, and operations. This role requires strong leadership, deep hands-on technical skills (ETL, data modeling, SQL, MDM), and the ability to leverage platforms like Databricks for enterprise data solutions. A critical aspect is acting as a liaison with key business leaders to ensure data initiatives directly drive business value and compliance. Working hours: US business hours till 4 PM ET.


Responsibilities:

  • Define and execute a forward-thinking data governance strategy and roadmap. Build a scalable, adaptive framework that ensures compliance while facilitating the adoption of AI and GenAI technologies.
  • Lead the end-to-end development of enterprise ontologies and knowledge graphs, including schema design, reasoning rules, and alignment. Create scalable semantic models using RDF/OWL/SPARQL .
  • Integrate structured and unstructured sources into the semantic layer through schema mapping and harmonization. Conduct ontology validations, entity reconciliation, and SPARQL-based quality checks.
  • Oversee data cataloging, provenance, master data management (MDM), and metadata management. Establish standards for versioning control and change management.
  • Facilitate cross-departmental initiatives to establish a common data language. Provide insights on data investments and promote best practices across technical and functional teams.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent.
  • 10+ years in data management/governance with a proven record in leadership roles.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in ontology engineering and knowledge graph development . Advanced proficiency in RDF, OWL, and SPARQL
  • Practical experience with Stardog, Metaphacts, or GraphDB
  • Proficiency in platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Topbraid EDG, Erwin, or LeanIX.
  • Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with Python for automation.
  • Strong understanding of integrating relational, NoSQL, and semi-structured data. Experience with cloud environments (Azure preferred).
  • Demonstrated success in transforming data practices within large, complex organizations and leading cross-functional teams.


Will be a plus:

  • Experience with reasoning engines, inference rules, and schema harmonization.
  • Familiarity with Google Knowledge Graph tools (Schema Tool, Critique, Cider).
  • Domain modeling experience in cloud infrastructure, software, or asset management.
  • Certifications in Azure or semantic technologies (Stardog, Metaphacts).



We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.g., LinkedIn, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Analista de Revenue Operations (RevOps)
description:

Buscamos um(a) Analista de RevOps estratégico(a), analítico(a) e articulador(a), capaz de garantir a fluidez e integração da jornada de receita — do marketing ao pós-venda — e impulsionar nosso crescimento sustentável.

Como Analista de Revenue Operations, você será parte integrante do time de BizOps, atuando como elo entre as áreas comerciais, marketing, customer success e operações. Sua visão holística e habilidades analíticas serão essenciais para estruturar processos, definir métricas e conduzir projetos de alto impacto.


Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear, estruturar e otimizar processos de receita (pré e pós-venda), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em Revenue Operations, Business Operations, Sales Ops ou CS Ops.
  • Domínio de métricas SaaS (CAC, LTV, MRR, churn, etc.).
  • Vivência com gestão de CRM (preferencialmente HubSpot).
  • Excel/Google Sheets avançado e experiência com análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Looker Studio, Metabase, Power BI, etc.).
