Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Graphic Designer (Toys and Baby Gear)
description:
About Us:

Move2Play is a rapidly growing kids toy company in the e-commerce space. We were founded with a mission to create unique, interactive toys that get kids moving. We're a small but enthusiastic team that likes to work hard, move quickly, and bring thoughtful, engaging products to families across the country.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help shape the visual identity of our products from concept to shelf.


Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. This role focuses on graphic design execution for toys and baby gear products — including packaging, print artwork, character illustration, surface graphics, color studies, and visual concept development.


The ideal candidate has strong illustration skills, a sharp eye for color and composition, and experience creating graphics that resonate with both kids and modern parents. This is not an industrial design or soft goods design role — it is a graphics-first position embedded within product development.


**Portfolio or personal website is required.

**Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.


Salary:

30-40K USD | 5-15% Bonus



Responsibilities:

  • Create original character illustrations and playful graphics for toys and baby products
  • Develop surface artwork for products (prints, patterns, decals, labels, etc.)
  • Conduct color studies and create cohesive color palettes across product lines
  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção; buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.

  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires.   • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk

  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

description:
Descrição da Vaga (JD):

O desenvolvedor ServiceNow fará parte de uma equipe já estabelecida, apoiando a implementação do módulo Application Portfolio Management (APM) do ServiceNow. O profissional será responsável por ativar e configurar o módulo, além de trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times funcionais para definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.


Como Especialista Técnico de Aplicações, você poderá esperar:

▪ Formular e definir o escopo e os objetivos do sistema.

▪ Ser responsável pelo design do programa, codificação, testes, depuração e documentação.

▪ Ter conhecimento técnico e responsabilidade por todas as fases de análise e programação de sistemas de aplicações.

▪ Compreender o negócio ou a função para a qual a aplicação está sendo projetada.

▪ Aprender continuamente sobre novas tecnologias, gerar novas ideias e melhorar o uso de tecnologias modernas em todo o portfólio de aplicações.

▪ Configurar e ativar o Application Portfolio Management (APM).

▪ Desenvolver relacionamentos de Itens de Configuração (CIs) para Capacidades de Negócio, Objetos de Informação, Aplicações de Negócio e Serviços de Aplicação.

▪ Integrar o APM com outros módulos do ServiceNow, incluindo ITSM e SAM.

▪ Utilizar fortes competências técnicas e expertise para identificar, analisar e solucionar problemas em produção, mantendo procedimentos que atendam às expectativas dos usuários de negócio.

▪ Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais e times de desenvolvimento para entender e fornecer soluções/correções automatizadas.

▪ Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de Delivery e Suporte, bem como para a maturidade dos diferentes portfólios, capacidades, especializações e melhores práticas, considerando as necessidades e requisitos dos usuários e stakeholders.

▪ Participar de eventos SCRUM e concluir os itens atribuídos dentro da meta definida para a Sprint.

▪ Reunir-se com stakeholders-chave e acompanhar os itens de ação para quaisquer soluções alternativas necessárias, de acordo com a natureza dos requisitos.

Qualificações e Requisitos


Qualificações essenciais

• Graduação ou Mestrado em Computação, Eletrônica ou área relacionada

• Certificação ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA)

• Certificação ServiceNow Certified Application Portfolio Management (APM) Implementer

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de comunicar informações técnicas para públicos não técnicos


Competências-chave

▪ 8 a 10 anos de experiência total na área de TI

▪ Conhecimento intermediário em linguagens de desenvolvimento: XML, HTML, CSS, Java e JavaScript

▪ Experiência na plataforma ServiceNow como Administrador e Desenvolvedor

▪ Experiência no desenvolvimento de Service Catalogs, implementação de ACLs, transform maps, Flows via Flow Designer, client scripts e métricas de saúde da CMDB

▪ Configuração de Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps e Information Objects

▪ Mais de 5 anos de experiência em administração ServiceNow nas seguintes áreas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs

▪ Experiência prévia com o módulo APM é desejável


Outras habilidades e competências

▪ Capacidade de adaptação rápida para aprender novas ferramentas, novas tecnologias e padrões atuais do mercado

▪ Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente global e distribuído, sem supervisão

▪ Perfil autodirigido, proativo e com pensamento sistêmico

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Hiring: Financial Controller

Company: Confidential

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: Full-time/Contract

Location: Remote (Open to those in Argentina, Brazil, Colombia)


Position Overview

Do you love utilizing forecasts to create strategic, financial insights?

Is creating budgets, reports, and maximizing cash flow your jam?

Are you currently employed as a Controller and eager for more fulfilling employment?


Then we would like to meet you!


A small to medium‑sized financial consulting firm is seeking a Controller who can manage core financial operations and help shape the business as it grows. This role combines traditional accounting oversight with leadership of the delivery team that supports clients with financial consulting services.

You’ll be a strong fit if you work well in a fast‑paced environment, take ownership, and balance strategic thinking with precise execution.

The firm serves small businesses ranging from mid‑six to eight figures in revenue across a variety of industries. In this role, you will support both the firm and its client portfolio, ensuring strong financial systems, clear reporting, and consistent delivery across engagements.

Key responsibilities include financial statements, budgeting and forecasting, internal controls, cash flow, payroll, and financial systems management. You will also help guide the consulting delivery team by overseeing financial processes used in client work and supporting the development of scalable delivery practices.

If you enjoy building structure, improving systems, and partnering with leadership to drive growth, this Controller role will be a great fit.


Responsibilities

  • Prepare Financial Statements: Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring accuracy and full compliance with US GAAP .
  • Financial Forecasting: Build reliable forecasts to project revenues, expenses, and financial trends for both the firm and client engagements.
  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain adherence to legal, regulatory, and internal accounting policies.
  • Manage Accounting Records: Oversee accurate financial records, including AP, AR, and general ledger management.
  • Implement Controls: Develop and enforce internal controls to safeguard assets and ensure data integrity.
  • Monitor Cash Flow: Track and manage cash flow to support operational needs and strategic initiatives.
  • Optimize Cash Utilization: Create strategies to improve liquidity, cash management, and investment decisions.
  • Support Strategic Planning: Provide financial insights that guide business strategy, growth planning, and decision‑making.
  • Evaluate Financial Performance: Analyze financial results and recommend improvements to achieve organizational and client goals.
  • Oversee Financial Systems: Manage and enhance financial software and reporting systems for efficiency and accuracy.
  • US Payroll Oversight: Manage or review W2 and contractor payroll processes to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
  • Lead the Delivery Team: Support and guide the financial consulting delivery team, ensuring consistent processes, high‑quality client work, and scalable operational practices.
  • Shape Operational Practices: Contribute to building and refining the firm’s financial delivery frameworks, systems, and internal processes.
  • Client Financial Services Support: Collaborate with consultants to support client financial operations and ensure strong service delivery across engagements.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of Controller or similar experience in finance or accounting
  • 3+ years of leadership experience , ideally overseeing teams or managing financial operations
  • Strong experience with US GAAP financial reporting
  • Experience with US payroll
  • Has a US CPA equivalent for Argentina, Brazil or Colombia
  • Background in client financial services or financial consulting
  • Strong ownership mindset and accountability
  • Action‑oriented and solution‑focused
  • High attention to detail
  • Collaborative and proactive in working with teams
  • Ambitious, driven, and eager to grow
  • Fast learner with strong adaptability
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced consulting environment


Additional requirements:

  • Located in Argentina, Brazil, or Colombia
  • Available to work between overlapping hours with 10 AM – 6 PM US Central Time Zone
  • Access to a computer and reliable high‑speed internet
  • Distraction‑free work environment
  • Able to prioritize this role as the primary professional focus
  • Demonstrates accountability, openness to feedback, and strong ownership of work and team contributions
  • Communicates professionally and maintains a clear, respectful tone in all correspondence


Offer Details

  • Pay is relative to the market of the country you live in.
  • This is a full-time contract position


Software Utilized by Company

QuickBooks, Gusto, Microsoft Excel, Slack, Google Suite, ClickUp, Puzzle, Causal

  • Complete assessment
  • Interview virtually with our US-based recruiting firm
  • Interview virtually with the CEO/owner

title: CLM Functional Support Analyst
description:
About UST


Born digital, UST transforms lives through the power of technology. We walk alongside our clients and partners, embedding innovation and agility into everything they do. We help them create transformative experiences and human-centered solutions for a better world.

UST is a mission-driven organization where people, purpose, and technology come together to create meaningful impact. With a strong people-first culture, we empower our teams to innovate, collaborate, and grow while delivering value to our clients and communities worldwide.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in CLM functional support or functional analysis roles.

At UST, you will work in a collaborative and inclusive environment where innovation, learning, and personal growth are encouraged. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, work with global teams, and build solutions that truly make a difference.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

- 5+ years of experience with Power BI development and engineering (DAX and semantic model development and deployment)

title: Digital Experience Solution Architect
description:
Join Toptal’s Elite Network of Freelance Talent

Toptal is an exclusive network of the world’s top freelance software developers, designers, finance experts, product managers, and project managers. As one of the fastest-growing fully remote networks globally, we empower professionals to thrive in their freelance careers while working with leading companies around the world.


About the Client

Our client is a global consumer goods leader dedicated to developing essential products, with a strong focus on innovation, sustainability, and responsible manufacturing.


Role: Digital Experience Solution Architect

Seeking an experienced Digital Experience Architect to lead the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and high-performing brand websites. This role drives technical strategy, personalization, and compliance across digital platforms while mentoring teams and fostering innovation.


About the Role

This is a high-impact role within a global consumer goods company, focused on modernizing digital brand experiences through MACH architecture and cloud-native solutions. The digital team is transitioning legacy platforms to composable, API-first environments to improve speed, performance, and personalization. Collaboration across marketing, legal, compliance, and engineering functions is essential to align technical architecture with business goals and regulatory standards. The team prioritizes innovation, sustainability, and inclusivity, with strong support for career development and hybrid work flexibility.


Task and Deliverables

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure digital solutions for global brand websites
  • Lead the transition to modern CMS systems using MACH principles (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless)
  • Integrate personalization tools and performance optimization techniques to drive measurable business outcomes
  • Ensure compliance with global privacy regulations (CPRA/CCPA, GDPR) and lead consent and data protection architecture
  • Maintain architectural documentation including roadmaps, runbooks, and system diagrams.
  • Provide full-stack technical leadership across frontend (React) and backend systems
  • Guide teams on technology selection, architecture best practices, and compliance integration
  • Ensure uptime and reliability through proactive monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis
  • Mentor team members, fostering a culture of technical excellence
  • Support legacy systems during phased migration to modern architecture


Requirements


Must Have:

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital platforms
  • Expertise in full-stack development (React frontend, CMS/backend, API-first integration)
  • Strong knowledge of MACH architecture and modern CMS platforms (headless and traditional)
  • Experience with Azure or AWS and cloud-native deployments
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, SQL, and web security best practices
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) and real-time personalization
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and event-based customer interaction flows
  • Exposure to eCommerce platforms and digital marketing technologies


Additional Details

  • Location: Remote in Brazil or Argentina
  • Type: 40h/week Contract
  • Duration: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)
  • Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship

Our teams partner closely with stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable, impactful solutions. At Pinnacle Group, we foster collaboration, continuous learning, and measurable results.


Summary

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst | Tableau who will serve as both a functional and technical partner to the business. This role is responsible for gathering requirements, defining KPIs, and designing robust Tableau dashboards using advanced calculations and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, business-focused, and capable of building scalable reporting solutions from scratch. This position requires strong stakeholder engagement skills and deep expertise in Tableau development.


Job Description

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather and document reporting requirements, define success metrics, and establish actionable KPIs.
  • Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end Tableau dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and advanced LOD expressions.
  • Translate business questions into scalable data models, visualizations, and performance-driven analytics solutions.
  • Create calculated fields, parameters, filters, and data blending solutions to support dynamic reporting needs.
  • Perform data validation, quality checks, and reconciliation to ensure accuracy and consistency of insights.
  • Optimize dashboard performance through efficient data modeling and query tuning.
  • Present findings and insights to business leaders, translating technical outputs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Continuously enhance reporting frameworks by identifying automation opportunities and implementing best practices in BI development.


Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Business Intelligence or Data Analytics with strong Tableau development expertise.
  • Demonstrated experience creating dashboards from scratch using complex calculations and LOD expressions.
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into measurable KPIs and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and large datasets.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and performance optimization techniques.
  • Ability to balance technical execution with business-facing communication and stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.


Why Join Pinnacle Group?

At Pinnacle Group, you will work on high-impact initiatives that directly influence business strategy and decision-making. We empower our employees to take ownership of their work while providing the support and resources needed for professional growth. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Joining our team means contributing to meaningful data-driven transformation while advancing your career in a dynamic, forward-thinking organization.


Instructions

Please answer the questions below, attach your resume and email your responses to the correct contacts as part of your application. Please email your resume and responses to: and .


  • Describe your experience building Tableau dashboards from scratch, including how many you have created, examples of complex calculations, LOD expressions you have implemented.
  • How do you approach gathering business requirements and translating them into measurable KPIs?

title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • +6 years significant experience with C++ (preferably C++11 or later);
  • Experience using GNU/Linux for development, shell scripting, and basic administration;
  • Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming languages and software architectures;
  • Solid understanding of distributed software architectures;
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • C1 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace
description:
Somos uma empresa especializada em estratégia, operação e crescimento de e-commerces e marketplaces, com forte atuação orientada a dados, tecnologia e performance.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Cadastro em Marketplace para atuar no processo de onboarding dos clientes, garantindo a correta integração de sistemas, cadastro de produtos e organização das informações nos canais de venda.

Essa posição exige atenção a detalhes, capacidade analítica e organização. Não buscamos alguém apenas rápido(a), mas alguém que tenha cuidado com processos, análise e qualidade das informações.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar no processo de onboarding de novos clientes após o fechamento comercial, organizando as etapas de cadastro e integração

• Realizar cadastro e atualização de produtos nos principais marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Magalu, Shopee, entre outros)

• Integrar hubs de anúncios com ERP, garantindo consistência entre sistemas e canais de venda

• Preencher fichas técnicas diretamente nos marketplaces, seguindo as diretrizes de cada plataforma

• Trabalhar com ferramentas como Magis5, Bling e sistemas de conciliação, apoiando a estruturação operacional das contas

• Organizar e tratar dados em Excel e Google Sheets para controle e atualização de cadastros

• Monitorar possíveis inconsistências entre sistemas, anúncios e produtos cadastrados

• Participar das rotinas diárias com o time (daily meetings) para alinhamento das demandas e prioridades

• Atuar de forma resolutiva, acompanhando a lista de demandas priorizadas pela liderança da área


Requisitos

• Excel intermediário

• Experiência com cadastro de produtos ou operações em marketplaces

• Organização, atenção a detalhes e senso de responsabilidade

• Perfil proativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender

• Facilidade para trabalhar com processos estruturados e demandas simultâneas


Diferenciais

• Experiência com hubs de integração (Magis5, Anymarket, Tray ou similares)

• Vivência em operações multicanal e e-commerce

• Conhecimento de diferentes marketplaces

• Experiência com ERP Bling ou sistemas de conciliação


O que oferecemos

• Remuneração de R$ 3.000,00 (PJ)

• Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo

• Oportunidade de aprendizado contínuo em operação de marketplaces

• Atuação próxima a projetos reais de crescimento dos clientes


Modelo de trabalho

• 100% remoto

• Contratação PJ

• Participação em alinhamentos diários com o time

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Description

Join codevista as an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript in a fully remote role. Build and maintain web applications using modern JavaScript technologies like React and Node.js. Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere in Brazil, with collaborative tools and a supportive team environment tailored for beginners eager to grow their skills.

As an entry-level Full Stack Developer - JavaScript at codevista, you'll dive into the exciting world of web development while working remotely from anywhere in Brazil. This role is perfect for recent graduates or those with basic programming experience who are passionate about JavaScript and ready to contribute to real-world projects.

Your primary responsibilities will include developing user-facing features using frontend frameworks like React or Vue.js, integrating with backend services built on Node.js and Express, and working with databases such as MongoDB or PostgreSQL. You'll collaborate on building scalable web applications, fixing bugs, and optimizing performance for our clients' needs. Since this is an entry-level position, expect hands-on guidance from senior developers to help you learn best practices in agile methodologies and version control with Git.

Remote work is at the core of our setup at codevista. You'll use tools like Slack for daily communication, Zoom for team meetings and stand-ups, and Jira or Trello for task tracking. We foster a collaborative culture through virtual pair programming sessions and weekly knowledge-sharing calls, ensuring you're never isolated despite the distance. Time zones are considered, with core hours aligned to São Paulo time for seamless teamwork.

Technologies you'll work with include HTML5, CSS3 (with preprocessors like Sass), JavaScript (ES6+), and RESTful APIs. On the backend, you'll handle authentication, data validation, and deployment using platforms like Heroku or AWS basics. For an entry-level role, we emphasize learning over perfection—expect mentorship to build your foundational skills in full-stack development.

This position offers a supportive environment to grow your career. You'll participate in code reviews to understand clean code principles and contribute to open-source inspired projects internally. Remote flexibility means you can balance work with personal life, while our team ensures regular feedback to accelerate your professional development. Join us to turn your JavaScript passion into a rewarding remote career at codevista.

Requirements

  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
  • Familiarity with at least one frontend framework (e.g., React) and backend runtime (e.g., Node.js)
  • Understanding of REST APIs and basic database concepts
  • Strong self-motivation and time management skills for independent remote work
  • Excellent communication abilities for virtual team collaboration
  • Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace

title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


We’re excited to share that Innodata Inc. is expanding its AI and Machine Learning Talent Network , and we’re looking for passionate, detail-oriented professionals to join us as Data Annotators and Content Moderators (Review & Labeling) .

If you enjoy working with data, have a strong eye for detail, and wish to contribute to real-world AI innovation , this is a wonderful opportunity to become part of a forward-thinking global team .

Location: Brazil.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review, label, and moderate online content (may include sensitive material).
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and overall quality.
  • Contribute to building AI training datasets for next-generation systems.
  • Provide feedback and insights to enhance ongoing processes.


Requirements

  • Minimum qualification: Bachelors (or higher) .
  • Strong command of English (written and verbal) .
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills .
  • Comfortable working with diverse content types.
  • Access to a private, secure workspace with stable internet .


If you’re detail-oriented, tech-curious , and eager to contribute to the future of AI , we’d love to have you in our growing network.

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

title: Sr. DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Sr. DevOps Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a DevOps Engineer to support CI/CD pipelines, improve automation, and ensure the reliability of production systems. You’ll work closely with development and infrastructure teams to streamline deployments, enhance performance, and maintain secure, scalable environments.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and improve build/deployment pipelines.
  • Administer Azure DevOps (permissions, branching, policies).
  • Support deployments using tools like Octopus Deploy.
  • Troubleshoot build and deployment issues.
  • Monitor production environments and coordinate upgrades.
  • Implement automation to reduce technical debt and improve CI/CD efficiency.
  • Assist with infrastructure management using Chef, Terraform, or similar tools.
  • Maintain documentation and communicate project status to stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • Microsoft system administration experience.
  • Active Directory, Windows Server, and IIS knowledge.
  • Familiarity with .NET environments and Git.
  • PowerShell scripting skills.
  • Linux administration experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Chef/Terraform).
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience in agile development environments.


What Our Client Offers

  • 100% remote work in Brazil.
  • Modern DevOps tools and technologies.
  • Collaborative, growth-focused engineering culture.

title: Analista de PCP Senior
description:
O que irá fazer:

  • Atuar no Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) de forma integrada ao planejamento de materiais e à gestão operacional de contratos de terceiros, garantindo aderência ao plano produtivo, equilíbrio entre oferta e demanda e atendimento aos prazos acordados.
  • Elaborar e revisar o plano de produção, considerando níveis de estoque, lead time de fornecedores e parceiros, sazonalidade da demanda e capacidade produtiva disponível, assegurando eficiência operacional e resposta rápida a desvios.
  • Realizar a programação diária e acompanhamento das linhas de produção de terceiros, monitorando volumes, prazos, qualidade e performance contratual, com capacidade de reprogramação diante de alterações de demanda ou restrições operacionais.
  • Planejar e controlar materiais, realizando levantamento de faltas, acompanhamento de entregas e liberações junto à área de Garantia da Qualidade, prevenindo rupturas e impactos na produção.
  • Abrir e gerenciar ordens de produção e pedidos, conforme políticas de estoque e contratos vigentes, garantindo alinhamento entre planejamento, suprimentos e operação.
  • Atender a área Comercial, fornecendo informações confiáveis sobre prazos de entrega, capacidade produtiva e viabilidade de atendimento às demandas de clientes.
  • Avaliar e revisar parâmetros de compra, manter cadastros de materiais atualizados no sistema, incluindo novos itens, produtos especiais e amostras, assegurando consistência das informações.
  • Analisar produtos de baixa movimentação, propondo planos de ação para mitigação de riscos, redução de obsolescência e descarte, com foco em eficiência e controle de custos.
  • Programar a produção de novos produtos, itens especiais e amostras, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas, comerciais e operacionais.

O que precisa ter:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Engenharias ou áreas afins;
  • Excel em nível avançado (obrigatório);
  • Experiência comprovada em PCP, Planejamento de Materiais e contratos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ERP, preferencialmente SAP (desejável);
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado (diferencial).

title: Sr. IT Operations Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

﻿

Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior IT Operations Engineer  to build and lead their IT operations practice from the ground up. This is a foundational role. They will be the first hire dedicated to IT operations and will be responsible for creating the infrastructure, processes, and playbooks that will define how IT services are delivered to startup clients.


This role requires a high degree of self-direction and autonomy. They will work with cloud-native startup environments, manage relationships with third-party service providers, and serve as the technical escalation point for complex IT issues. They will also be client-facing, responsible for onboarding new clients, setting expectations, and communicating progress.


Key Responsibilities:

Build IT Operations Infrastructure

  • Design and implement IT operations processes, procedures, and documentation from scratch
  • Create standardized onboarding playbooks, runbooks, and configuration templates
  • Establish best practices for identity and access management, device management, and security configurations
  • Build a scalable foundation that can support multiple concurrent client engagements


Client Engagement & Onboarding

  • Lead client onboarding for IT operations, including requirements gathering and timeline setting
  • Develop and present onboarding plans that set clear expectations with clients
  • Communicate technical requirements and progress to non-technical stakeholders
  • Serve as the primary IT operations contact for assigned clients


Technical Operations

  • Implement and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including SSO configurations
  • Deploy and maintain Mobile Device Management (MDM) for macOS and Windows environments
  • Configure and manage cloud-native tooling across client environments
  • Handle escalated help desk tickets that require senior-level expertise
  • Manage relationships with third-party service providers, including help desk vendors


Documentation & Process Development

  • Document all configurations, processes, and procedures as they are built
  • Create and maintain SOPs that enable consistent service delivery
  • Develop training materials and knowledge base articles


Requirements:

Required Experience

  • 6+ years of IT operations experience
  • Managed Service Provider (MSP) experience is required; this is non-negotiable
  • Experience with Jamf Pro or Similar MDM for macOS device management, enrollment, configuration profiles, and policy enforcement.
  • Deep expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions
  • Extensive experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) for both macOS and Windows
  • Strong background in cloud-native environments and modern SaaS tooling
  • Experience working directly with customers in a client-facing capacity


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, or Google Workspace
  • Hands-on experience with MDM platforms such as Jamf Pro, Intune, or Kandji
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and cloud-native architectures
  • Understanding of security best practices and how IT controls support compliance frameworks


Soft Skills

  • Exceptional self-direction and ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills, ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences
  • Documentation-first mindset, naturally creating SOPs and runbooks while working
  • Comfortable setting and managing expectations with clients
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously


What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to build something from the ground up and shape the direction of a growing practice
  • Work with innovative, fast-growing startup clients across various industries
  • Remote-first culture with flexible working arrangements
  • Direct access to company leadership and influence over strategic decisions
  • Growth trajectory into more senior technical roles as the practice expands


Working Hours:

This is a remote position. Candidates must be able to work during Eastern Time Zone or Pacific Time Zone business hours to ensure overlap with clients and team members.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Tech Lead | Marketplace
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead para evoluir um Marketplace digital de plataforma, com impacto direto na expansão do ecossistema, na geração de valor e na experiência dos clientes.

O desafio envolve evoluir uma plataforma de produtos digitais integrada, escalável e orientada a crescimento. Como Tech Lead, você terá papel central em transformar visão de produto em soluções técnicas sustentáveis e prontas para escala.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução de produtos de plataforma, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura, equilibrando integração, autonomia e experiência unificada.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e contribuir hands-on com o time.
  • Trabalhar próximo a produto e stakeholders, apoiando decisões e trade-offs técnicos.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, promovendo boas práticas e excelência técnica.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência na construção de produtos digitais de plataforma, como marketplaces, portais ou ecossistemas orientados a crescimento (PQL / PLG).
  • Forte base em arquitetura de software e sistemas distribuídos, aplicando Clean Architecture e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Vivência sólida em backend distribuído, com microserviços em Java/Kotlin (Spring Boot), APIs REST e contratos OpenAPI.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e comunicação assíncrona, garantindo resiliência e consistência entre serviços.
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL) e modelagem orientada a domínio.
  • Vivência com observabilidade em sistemas distribuídos, incluindo métricas e rastreamento ponta a ponta.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud, com CI/CD, containers e múltiplos ambientes.
  • Conhecimento de frontend moderno, incluindo React e TypeScript.
  • Atuação como Tech Lead, definindo padrões técnicos e orientando times de engenharia.
  • Experiência prévia com marketplaces digitais ou plataformas de monetização.
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade avançada, performance e escalabilidade
  • Atuação em produtos com integrações complexas e múltiplos domínios de negócio.


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Pleno (Full Stack com foco em IA)
description:
Na DreamSquad , criamos soluções digitais baseadas em IA Generativa que resolvem desafios reais de negócio com arquitetura moderna, escalável e orientada a performance. Atuamos de ponta a ponta — da concepção à produção — integrando agentes de IA, pipelines de RAG, bancos de dados e infraestrutura em cloud com foco em impacto, qualidade e experiência do usuário.


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software Pleno (Full Stack com foco em IA) para atuar na construção de produtos inteligentes, conectando backend em Python/FastAPI a interfaces modernas em React/Next.js. Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, que goste de arquitetura, performance e boas práticas, e que queira participar ativamente das decisões técnicas — desde a implementação de APIs e pipelines de RAG até a otimização de latência, consumo de tokens e integração com serviços AWS.


Principais Atividades:

Desenvolvimento de Produtos de IA

  • Desenvolver o backend utilizando Python e FastAPI , conectando com o frontend em React / Next.js .
  • Criar interfaces para interação com Agentes de IA , como chats, dashboards e visualizações de dados.
  • Garantir uma experiência fluida e performática para o usuário final.

Arquitetura e Implementação de RAG

  • Implementar pipelines de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) no backend.
  • Desenvolver componentes visuais que exibam fontes e referências recuperadas via Vector Stores (ex: Vector S3) .
  • Otimizar o fluxo de dados entre frontend, backend e serviços de IA na AWS.

Qualidade, Integração e Performance

  • Integrar agentes de IA com bancos de dados transacionais.
  • Monitorar latência, consumo de tokens e tempo de resposta dos modelos.
  • Garantir usabilidade, escalabilidade e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Backend

  • Python avançado, com uso de Type Hints , programação assíncrona (asyncio/FastAPI ) e padrões de projeto.
  • Desenvolvimento e documentação de APIs RESTful (OpenAPI/Swagger).
  • Conhecimento em autenticação, autorização, microsserviços e gerenciamento de dependências.

Frontend

  • JavaScript moderno e TypeScript (ES6+) .
  • Experiência com frameworks SPA baseados em componentes (React, Vue.js ou similares ).
  • Consumo de APIs REST, tratamento de estados assíncronos e erros.
  • Gerenciamento de estado (Context API, Redux, Zustand ou similares).
  • Estilização com CSS moderno, Tailwind, Styled Components ou similares.

Dados e Cloud

  • Modelagem e otimização de bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL ou MariaDB ).
  • Versionamento com Git (Git Flow, Code Review).
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema AWS .
  • Familiaridade com integração de modelos de IA generativa (LLMs) .


Diferenciais

  • Streaming em tempo real com WebSockets ou SSE .
  • Experiência com AWS Bedrock , Strands Agents SDK ou interfaces conversacionais.
  • Uso de bancos de dados vetoriais (Vector S3, Pinecone, pgvector ).
  • Docker e Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ).
  • Testes automatizados no backend (Pytest ) e frontend (Jest, Cypress, Testing Library ).

title: Data Architect (Data Modeling & Optimization)
description:
About You

You are a Data Architect with a strong focus on designing, optimizing, and scaling high-performance data solutions. You enjoy working close to the database layer and understanding how architectural decisions directly impact performance, scalability, and reliability. You are comfortable owning data architecture decisions end to end and thrive in environments where deep technical expertise, autonomy, and collaboration with engineering teams are essential.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in data architecture, database architecture, or similar roles with a strong focus on performance optimization.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating data solutions on AWS, with strong preference for RDS and Aurora.
  • Advanced expertise in SQL, including complex query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, and stored procedure development.
  • Deep understanding of how CPU, memory, storage, and I/O constraints impact database and data architecture performance.
  • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.
  • Strong proficiency using GitHub for version control, collaboration, and documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of architectural decisions, and drive improvements end to end.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality and system performance.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with distributed and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, evolve, and maintain data architectures that prioritize performance, scalability, and reliability on AWS RDS and Aurora.
  • Analyze and optimize database workloads through SQL performance tuning, query refactoring, and advanced indexing strategies.
  • Identify architectural and infrastructure-level bottlenecks related to CPU, memory, storage, and I/O, proposing scalable solutions.
  • Define and enforce data modeling and architectural standards for high-performance transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers and technical teams to ensure strong alignment between application and data layers.
  • Establish and promote best practices for database performance monitoring, optimization, and reliability across environments.
  • Review and optimize stored procedures and complex SQL logic from an architectural and performance perspective.
  • Document data architecture decisions, performance guidelines, and optimization strategies.
  • Act as a technical reference and advisor for data architecture and performance topics across teams.
  • Support technical discussions with stakeholders by providing clear recommendations and trade-off analyses.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.
