title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

title: React Application Architect
description:
About You

You are an Application Architect specializing in marketing technology and digital analytics platforms. You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact.

You are comfortable operating across marketing, analytics, and engineering teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear guidance, and defining standards that improve data quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture, marketing technology, or analytics engineering roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of React , JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to implement and debug complex tracking solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Tag Manager, including custom JavaScript variables and structured data layer implementations.
  • Strong experience implementing and governing Google Analytics 4, including event modeling and advanced tracking strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Pixel, and Conversions API.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking and remarketing integrations.
  • Proven experience designing client-side and server-side tracking architectures.
  • Strong understanding of privacy regulations, Consent Mode, and browser restrictions (ITP) and their impact on data collection.
  • Experience using browser developer tools and tag debugging extensions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Architect and implement a modular, scalable application architecture for marketing data collection and digital analytics.
  • Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers.
  • Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations.
  • Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations.
  • Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level tracking and performance issues affecting data accuracy or site stability.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions.
  • Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles.
  • 5+ years of experience with React.
  • Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4.
  • Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API.
  • Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.


Additional Information

About Us

We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of \"alignment sessions\" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is \"swamped.\" Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The \"innovation\" is a lie. They said \"move fast and break things\" in the job post. What they meant was \"move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit.\" We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say \"this changes everything.\" That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is \"competitive\" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's \"strategic initiative.\" Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think \"there has to be a better way.\"

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't \"use AI sometimes.\" This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI

If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

title: Conversational AI Engineer
description:
The Conversational AI Engineer is the primary agent builder, responsible for developing and deploying intelligent conversational agents using Google Dialogflow CX. This role owns the conversation layer—from NLU model training and dialog flow implementation through webhook fulfillment and multi-channel deployment. Works shoulder-to-shoulder with the Architect on complex features and consumes RAG/LLM components built by the AI/ML Engineer. Performs preliminary technical testing on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA for functional validation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement conversational flows, intents, entities, and page/route structures in Dialogflow CX based on user stories and conversation design specifications.
  • Develop webhook fulfillment services in Python or Node.js to handle business logic, API calls, and dynamic responses.
  • Conduct NLU training, testing, and optimization to improve intent recognition accuracy and entity extraction.
  • Integrate generative AI components (built by the AI/ML Engineer) into agent flows—including LLM-powered responses, knowledge retrieval, and summarization features.
  • Deploy and configure agents across channels: web chat, telephony (CCAI), Google Chat, WhatsApp, and custom applications.
  • Design and implement webhook contracts and data schemas between Dialogflow CX agents and n8n workflows (built by the Automation Engineer).
  • Build and maintain n8n workflows for agent fulfillment when scope is straightforward, escalating complex automation to the Automation & Integration Engineer.
  • Implement error handling, fallback strategies, escalation logic, and graceful degradation in agent flows.
  • Perform preliminary technical testing (conversation path testing, webhook validation, intent accuracy checks, regression tests) on all personal deliverables before handoff to the BA.
  • Pair-program with the Architect on complex integrations and participate in code reviews.
  • Manage Dialogflow CX versioning, environment promotion, and agent deployment pipelines.
  • Participate in sprint planning and provide technical estimates for user stories.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building conversational AI solutions, chatbots, or voice agents.
  • Strong proficiency with Google Dialogflow CX (flows, pages, routes, webhooks, test cases).
  • Advanced development skills in Python and/or Node.js with experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Understanding of NLU concepts: intent classification, entity extraction, context management, slot filling.
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud services: Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore, BigQuery.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise APIs and SaaS platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, Slack).
  • Hands-on experience with n8n (preferred) or comparable automation platforms (Make, Zapier) for building workflows.
  • Proficiency with version control (Git), CI/CD, and agile development practices.
  • Disciplined approach to testing: comfortable writing unit tests, integration tests, and conversation test cases.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Vertex AI Agent Builder or Vertex AI Search and Conversation.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar LLM orchestration frameworks.
  • Experience deploying agents in multilingual environments.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text and text-to-speech services (Google Cloud Speech APIs).
  • Experience with telephony and contact center integrations.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos

No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.


No Brasil, a ENGIE , empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás , e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.


A ENGIE Serviços de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG , a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integradade soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (React + UX/UI + AI-Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley–based product company building a next‑generation B2B single-page application used daily by enterprise customers. We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who is both a hands-on React expert and a strong UX/UI thinker, someone who can own the user experience end‑to‑end, from concept to polished production implementation.


This is a role for a self-directed, highly motivated engineer who can hit the ground running, collaborate closely with product/design, and loves leveraging the latest AI tools to accelerate design, coding, testing, and iteration.


What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and deliver modern, high-performance React applications for a complex B2B SaaS product.
  • Translate product concepts and user workflows into frictionless UX flows, wireframes, and pixel-perfect UI components.
  • Collaborate with Product, and Backend teams to shape features from idea to release.
  • Implement real-time features using SignalR and other websocket technologies.
  • Work with AI agents and tools daily for coding, refactoring, UI generation, documentation, and test creation.
  • Write automated tests with Playwright and other testing frameworks.
  • Drive UI performance, accessibility, and maintainability best practices.
  • Think holistically: not just “take tasks,” but help shape the product, the experience, and the architecture.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Full US Pacific Time availability (not partial overlap).
  • Fluent verbal and written English; comfortable with daily video-based collaboration .
  • 5+ years of hands-on React experience (hooks, context, state management, component architecture).
  • Strong UX/UI sensibility—capable of producing or improving wireframes, interaction flows, and visual details.
  • Experience working directly from Figma or similar UI tools.
  • Experience with real-time applications (SignalR preferred but not required).
  • Comfort with Node.js for lightweight tooling or UI-supporting backends.
  • Familiarity with Electron , WebSockets , and HTML5 .
  • Regular, disciplined use of AI tools for development.
  • Strong communication, accountability, and a bias toward problem-solving.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with B2B SaaS products and complex user workflows.
  • Understanding of frontend architecture patterns at scale.
  • Background in design systems or component libraries.
  • Experience in performance tuning for real-time or heavy-data UIs.


Who You Are

  • A team player with strong ownership and bias for action.
  • Someone who enjoys “figuring things out” rather than waiting for instructions.
  • A builder who can think outside the box , challenge assumptions, and propose better solutions.
  • A believer in AI-accelerated engineering and modern best practices.
  • A product-mindset engineer who cares deeply about user experience—from pixels to workflows.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a tight‑knit, fast-moving team where your work directly shapes the product experience. You’ll have the autonomy to influence UI/UX direction, introduce best practices, and work with a modern AI-enabled workflow that rewards creativity and initiative.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


If you’re a systems expert who thrives in cloud‑driven, enterprise environments and you want a fully remote role with real technical ownership, this opportunity will give you the autonomy, complexity, and impact you’re looking for.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, directory services, cloud environments, and enterprise server administration. In this role, you’ll support and optimize core infrastructure, improve system reliability, modernize environments, and play a critical part in supporting global teams.


This is the perfect position for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working with a modern Microsoft‑centered stack.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize VMware environments, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, identity management, and group policy
  • Support and maintain Windows Server environments across production and staging platforms
  • Implement and manage Azure cloud services, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations
  • Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of critical infrastructure
  • Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation efforts
  • Support infrastructure automation, documentation, and best‑practice improvements
  • Collaborate with global IT teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and enhancements
  • Maintain security standards and ensure compliance across systems and environments


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience
  • Strong hands‑on experience with VMware virtualization
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory administration
  • Experience managing and maintaining Windows Server environments
  • Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls, routing preferred)
  • Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally in a remote environment
  • Ability to manage priorities and self‑direct in a distributed team structure


What Our Client Offers

  • Fully remote role based in Brazil with global team collaboration
  • Opportunity to work with modern virtualization and cloud infrastructure
  • High‑impact systems ownership with strong visibility across IT leadership
  • Professional development, cloud learning resources, and certification support
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and long‑term growth opportunities
  • A collaborative, engineering‑minded culture that values innovation and continuous improvement

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Instructional Designer/Training Content Creator


*English Resume Only

Role Type: Full-Time Contract

Hours: Must be willing to work US EST Hours

Location: Brazil

Reporting To: VP of Operations


About The Methodical Group


The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity


Our client, a growing SaaS organization within the healthcare sector, is seeking an experienced Instructional Designer / Content Training Creator to support product adoption and end-user engagement.

This individual will be responsible for developing high-quality training materials aligned to new feature releases and product enhancements. Content will include step-by-step documentation, video tutorials, and embedded in-app learning resources.

The ideal candidate is structured, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative — capable of working cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to ensure training materials are accurate, timely, and aligned with customer needs.

This role directly supports customer adoption, user enablement, and long-term retention.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • 3–6+ years of experience in instructional design, technical writing, or SaaS training content creation
  • Experience creating both written documentation and video tutorials
  • Strong ability to translate technical product features into user-friendly materials
  • Experience supporting SaaS product releases
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience
  • Familiarity with knowledge base or help desk platforms
  • Experience embedding or structuring in-app training resources preferred


Preferred Experience


  • Experience within healthcare or other regulated SaaS environments
  • Experience supporting product adoption initiatives
  • Familiarity with user enablement or digital adoption strategies
  • Experience working in fast-paced, release-driven environments


Key Responsibilities


Training Content Development

  • Develop clear, structured training materials for new feature releases and product updates
  • Create step-by-step documentation, user guides, and process walkthroughs
  • Produce video tutorials and screen-recorded demonstrations
  • Maintain consistent instructional design standards across all materials

Product Release Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and internal stakeholders during the feature release lifecycle
  • Translate technical functionality into user-friendly instructional content
  • Document workflows, use cases, and feature capabilities
  • Track release timelines to ensure training materials are delivered in sync with launch

Content Maintenance & Optimization

  • Audit and update existing training materials as product functionality evolves
  • Ensure documentation accuracy and consistency
  • Identify content gaps impacting user adoption
  • Improve clarity and accessibility of user-facing materials

Platform & Knowledge Base Integration

  • Prepare content for embedding within the application and support platform
  • Organize materials for easy user navigation and searchability
  • Support continuous improvement of knowledge base structure

Adoption & Enablement Support

  • Create content that drives end-user adoption of key modules and features
  • Develop materials aligned to different user personas
  • Monitor feedback from Customer Success and Support teams to refine training assets

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

Identificar novas oportunidades para melhoria de processos;

Monitorar e solucionar problemas de infraestrutura de dados, garantir que os sistemas de dados estejam sempre

Organização para gerenciar grandes volumes de dados e processos críticos.

Conhecimento de práticas de segurança de dados, entender como proteger dados contra acessos não

Dinâmico e ágil;

Trabalhar em equipe;

Gestão do tempo;

Atenção aos detalhes;

Will be a plus:

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a hands-on DevOps or Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys taking ownership of Infrastructure as Code and building reliable, cloud-native environments on AWS. You are comfortable working with Terraform, provisioning container-based infrastructure, and ensuring platform stability through proper monitoring and observability.


You bring a proactive mindset, enjoy questioning technical decisions, and collaborate closely with distributed teams to continuously improve infrastructure reliability, security, and scalability.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud , including writing modules and managing provisioning workflows.
  • Proven experience provisioning and managing AWS infrastructure , primarily ECS and related container services.
  • Deep understanding of Docker and container-based architectures.
  • Experience implementing monitoring and observability using CloudWatch and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with compliance practices and security-driven infrastructure changes.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, comfortable reviewing and questioning technical decisions and architectures.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Write and maintain Terraform code and modules to provision and manage AWS infrastructure using Terraform Cloud.
  • Review Terraform pull requests and provide feedback to ensure code quality and best practices.
  • Provision AWS services and work on proofs of concept (PoCs) to validate infrastructure solutions.
  • Apply infrastructure and configuration changes driven by Security and Compliance requirements.
  • Review and challenge architecture and implementation approaches to drive continuous improvement.
  • Participate in team ceremonies, including daily standups and technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure infrastructure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud.
  • Strong experience with AWS infrastructure (ECS and container services).
  • Experience with Docker, CloudWatch, and Datadog.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.
